dedupe_keys.name: ecobee donate your data 1 000 homes in 2017

description: This release contains an anonymised subset of ecobee Donate Your Data observations from 1,000 single-family homes in California, Texas, New York and Illinois. The DOE Benchmark Datasets for Buildings programme publishes five-minute thermostat records for 1 January through 31 December 2017, together with user-reported home and occupant characteristics. A raw archive contains twelve monthly CSV files. A processed archive contains twelve cleaned NetCDF files, a metadata JSON file and a Brick model describing the measurements. The public page identifies split cooling and furnace systems or heat pumps, with electricity and natural gas represented. Metadata and the CC0 public-domain licence can be read freely; signing in is required to browse or download the files. No account or file access was used in this review. A limitation is that voluntary participation, reported household attributes and anonymisation constrain population representativeness and spatial linkage. Cleaning was documented but not independently audited. Simulation uses include calibrating residential thermal dynamics and validating HVAC-operation or occupant-behaviour assumptions. The previously drafted ecobee building-controls simulator is software, whereas this record identifies the specific published observational subset.
name: Ecobee Donate Your Data 1,000 homes in 2017
notes: G8; G8-0276. Metadata and documentation checked. Data payloads and software execution were not tested. Simulation uses are curator interpretations.
